## Stereoscopic 3D: edge cleanup and hardware tuning

### Features
- **Edge Cleanup** (Off / Trim / Zoom): hides the screen-edge columns disturbed by per-layer parallax. Trim narrows the game window keeping the scale exact; Zoom crops absorbed by the stretch (default).
- **Enhanced Resolution** doubles the parallax scale and refines the 3D slider response to half-SNES-pixel steps; the blur aura scales 1.875x there.

### Fixes
- The right-eye texture is cleared on Enhanced Resolution changes - 3D no longer breaks after toggling the mode back and forth.
- Pause overlay ("Press START to resume") drawn one layer in front of the highest pop-out instead of at maximum depth (it was hard to read).
- IOD base restored to the Standard 3px: menu, splash and pause 3D were unintentionally running at maximum strength since the intensity picker was removed.
- Directory cache self-validates after 15 minutes: ROMs/MSU packs copied while the console was off appear without a manual rescan.
- Info/disabled menu colors made properly distinct; remaining stray blank lines removed.

### Credits
- Tyler Sanders credited for the original stereoscopic 3D groundwork.
